top_strength: Amy expertly gathered detailed inventory and logistics on a return customer, anchored the estimate to both time range and personalized factors (drive time, third floor, stairs), and locked the booking with a clear morning ETA.
coaching_note: Skip the Two Promises step entirely (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage were never delivered) — this is the biggest miss on the call; also add a genuine final concerns check in step 6 before closing, and ask a plain ask for the business without the built-in alternative of the afternoon window.
